info.title: Strand AI Platform API
info.description: REST surface for uploading WSIs, submitting Lattice inference jobs, and streaming results. All endpoints require an API key or Strand AI OAuth access token in the `Authorization: Bearer` header.

OAuth2.description: Strand AI authorization-code flow with S256 PKCE, explicit organization consent, and RFC 8707 resource binding.

uploadUrl.description: Resumable upload URL. Present for a new upload; omitted when `existing` is true.

existing.description: True when `contentSha256` matched an existing active upload in the same organization.

status.description: uploading | upload_failed | deid_running | deid_failed | preprocessing | ready | preprocess_failed

autoSegment.description: Resolved auto-segmentation decision for this upload (per-upload override, else org default, else true).

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null on last page

fullPanel.description: Whether this account is entitled to the full marker panel. `false` = the public panel only.

name.description: Marker name to pass to predict.

publicPanel.description: Whether this marker is part of the public panel.

downloadUrl.description: One-hour signed download URL. Present only when status is `ready`.

downloadUrlExpiresAt.description: Signed URL expiry. Present only when status is `ready`.

error.description: Export failure message. Present only when status is `failed`.

downloadUrl.description: One-hour signed download URL. Present only when status is `ready`.

downloadUrlExpiresAt.description: Signed URL expiry. Present only when status is `ready`.

ExpirationUpdate.description: Provide exactly one of `expiresAt`, `neverExpire: true`, or `useOrgDefault: true`. `neverExpire: true` is sugar for `expiresAt: null` (custom). `useOrgDefault: true` clears the custom expiration and follows the org's default policy.

name.description: Trimmed display name. Null or an empty string reverts to filename. NUL characters are rejected.

tags.description: Complete desired tag set, with a transport-safety limit of 1,000 raw items. Each value is trimmed/lowercased, then must be 1–50 characters with no commas or NUL characters; duplicates collapse after normalization and at most 50 distinct normalized tags are allowed.

mpp.description: User-reported microns per pixel. Object axes must be equal; anisotropic input is rejected.

OwnedSampleDetail.description: An owned sample's curated read model and its 50 newest inference jobs. `jobCount` is the uncapped total.

name.description: Human-friendly display name, or null if unset (falls back to filename).

fileSize.description: Uploaded file size in bytes (string-encoded 64-bit integer).

widthPx.description: Level-0 width in pixels, or null before the dimensions probe completes.

heightPx.description: Level-0 height in pixels, or null before the dimensions probe completes.

mpp.description: Effective isotropic microns per pixel (user override → calibrated slide value), or null when the sample has no usable scale yet.

tags.description: The sample's canonical tag strings, sorted alphabetically.

expiresAt.description: When the sample moves to Trash. Null when it never expires.

expiresAtSource.description: `org_default` = derived from the org policy at upload time. `custom` = set by an explicit expiration call (a date or a never-expire pin). Null when the sample has no expiration and no org policy applies.

expiresInDays.description: Whole days until expiry, clamped at 0 for a sample at/past its date but not yet swept. Null when the sample never expires.

willExpire.description: True when the sample has an expiration date set.

trashedAt.description: When the sample entered Trash, or null if it is still active. Trashed samples are permanently deleted 7 days after this time.

jobCount.description: Total inference-job count for the sample before the 50-job cap.

fileSize.description: Decimal string for a 64-bit byte count.

id.description: Safe public share UUID. Never an internal sample id.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next item, or null when exhausted.

PublicSampleDetail.description: A public sample's curated detail. `id` is the public share UUID; the internal sample identity and job history are never exposed.

thumbnailUrl.description: v1-relative path to the sample's JPEG thumbnail.

geometry.description: Level-0 pixel dimensions and microns-per-pixel of the H&E image.

viewer.description: How to read the pixel data: the OME-Zarr pyramid base path and the marker channels it carries.

pyramidUrl.description: v1-relative base path of the OME-Zarr store (`GET /public/samples/{publicId}/zarr/{...path}`). The root manifest is `{pyramidUrl}/zarr.json`.

markers.description: Live marker channels available in the pyramid.

get.summary: List uploads for the calling org
get.description: Returns non-archived uploads newest-first. Cursor-paginated; pass the prior response's `nextCursor` to fetch the next page.

post.description: Creates an organization-bound GCS resumable session for an already-de-identified slide. PUT the declared bytes to `uploadUrl`; when GCS finalizes the object, the platform automatically starts ingest preprocessing. Optional defense-in-depth de-identification runs only when enabled for the organization. There is no client finalize call. Poll `GET /uploads/{id}` until the sample leaves `uploading`.

contentSha256.description: Optional client-computed SHA-256. On a match within the calling organization, the response returns the existing upload and skips byte transfer.

autoSegment.description: Opt out of automatic cell segmentation for this upload. Defaults to the organization's `autoSegmentDefault` (true unless changed). When false, the slide is ingested and rendered but no segmentation job runs; marker runs still work but without cell-level readouts until segmented.

mpp.description: Optional user-reported microns per pixel, for callers that already know their slide's scale. Slides are isotropic: pass a number, or an { x, y } object whose axes are equal (anisotropic input is rejected). Persisted on the sample at creation and takes precedence over the slide's own calibrated value, so `POST /predict` works as soon as preprocessing finishes — no follow-up `PATCH /samples/{id}` needed. Ignored when `contentSha256` deduplicates to an existing sample (that sample's scale stands).

get.description: The entitlement-scoped catalog of markers this account may request. Credit-free. The list equals exactly what predict will accept: a self-signup account sees the public panel; a full-panel account sees the whole vocab. Use it to discover valid marker names upfront instead of trial-and-error against a 400.

post.description: Set `dryRun: true` to validate and price the prediction without writes or credit reservation (200). Omit it or set it to false to reserve credits atomically and enqueue preprocessing (202).

model.description: Optional explicit Lattice version. Only `v0.7` is dispatchable and is the current default; omit `model` to let the platform pick it. `v0.4`/`v0.5` are READ-ONLY as of 2026-06-23: they remain in this enum because they still appear on historical job records, but requesting one returns 400 `model_sunset` (with `currentDefault`). Legacy model strings return 400 `unknown_model`.

dryRun.description: When true, validates and returns the exact credit estimate without reserving credits, creating a job, or dispatching work.

200.description: Validated dry-run estimate with no side effects

403.description: One or more requested markers are outside this account's panel (`marker_not_available`).

post.description: Atomically flips `status` to `cancelled` and refunds the credit reservation. Returns 400 if the job is already terminal (`completed`, `failed`, or `cancelled`).

get.description: Server-Sent Events stream emitting JSON snapshots of `{status, progress, resultGcsPath}` on each pg_notify. Keep-alive heartbeats every 15s. Closes on terminal status.

404.description: No job matches the given id

get.summary: Get signed download URL for results
get.description: Returns a signed GCS URL for the OME-Zarr root metadata (`zarr.json`) plus the `resultBasePath` of the zarr store. Useful for clients that already have GCS credentials. SDK clients should generally prefer `GET /jobs/{id}/results/files/{path}` (API-key authenticated) for walking the tree.

404.description: No job matches the given id

post.description: Starts an asynchronous OME-TIFF export for a completed job. The request is idempotent: an in-progress or cached export is returned instead of starting a duplicate. Poll this same path with GET while the response status is `pending` or `running`.

get.description: Returns export status and, when ready, a one-hour signed download URL. Returns 404 `not_started` until an export has been requested with POST.

404.description: Job not found or export not started

post.summary: Request a whole-result OME-Zarr ZIP export
post.description: Starts or reuses a cached ZIP archive of the completed job's OME-Zarr tree. Poll this path with GET while pending or running.

get.description: Returns archive status and, when ready, a one-hour signed download URL.

404.description: Job not found or archive not started

get.summary: Get an owned or public sample
get.description: Resolve an org-owned sample id first, returning its curated detail and inference-job history. Otherwise resolve the same path value as a currently-public share UUID and return only public-safe detail.

404.description: Sample not found in this org

patch.description: Atomically update any combination of an owned sample's display name, complete tag set, and isotropic microns-per-pixel value. Public share ids are not patchable. OAuth callers need both `samples:read` and `samples:write` because the response includes full owned detail and job history. When countable `mpp` is supplied, an idempotent recount is enqueued even if the stored value is unchanged; after an enqueue-failure 500, retry the identical patch to heal the recount.

400.description: Body is not JSON, empty, or contains unknown fields

403.description: OAuth token lacks samples:read or samples:write, or the patch attempts to add/remove the reserved public tag

404.description: Owned sample not found in this org

500.description: The sample update committed but its MPP tissue recount could not be enqueued. Retry the identical patch to re-attempt the idempotent recount.

patch.description: Set a sample to expire on a specific date, set it to never expire, or clear any custom expiration and follow the org default. Caller must be the sample's creator, an org owner/admin, or a Strand AI admin.

404.description: Sample not found in this org

patch.description: All-or-nothing: if any sample fails the permission gate the whole call is rejected before any writes. Max 500 IDs per call.

403.description: One or more samples are not in the API key's org

post.description: Available within the 7-day Trash window. Brings the sample back to the active list and extends its expiration so it isn't immediately re-trashed. Same permission gate as the expiration endpoints.

404.description: Sample not found in this org

get.summary: Stream a single result file (API-key authenticated)
get.description: Proxies a single file from the OME-Zarr result store. `path` is the path within the zarr store (e.g. `zarr.json`, `CD3/zarr.json`, `CD3/c/0/0/0`). Authenticated via the same bearer API key as the rest of `/api/v1/`; org-scoped to the job. Use this when walking the zarr tree from a client that does not have direct GCS credentials.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path within the zarr store; slashes are not URL-encoded.

200.description: File bytes (binary for chunks, JSON for metadata).

get.description: List the calling organization's samples, the public cohort, or both. Cursor-paginated newest-first; `all` always emits mine first and de-duplicates owned public samples in favor of the mine representation. Credit-free.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned as `nextCursor`; not bound to page size.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Exact tag filter, normalized by trimming and lowercasing. Control characters and commas are rejected.

get.summary: Stream a public sample's OME-Zarr pyramid
get.description: Authenticated byte proxy for a public sample's OME-Zarr store — the H&E image (`he/...`) and every pinned marker channel (`markers/{marker}/...`). The root manifest is `zarr.json`. This is the way to read the actual marker pixel data. Only the `he/` and `markers/` namespaces are served; everything else is denied. Never reserves or spends credits.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path within the zarr store; slashes are not URL-encoded (e.g. `zarr.json`, `he/0/zarr.json`, `markers/CD3/c/0/0/0`).

200.description: File bytes (binary for chunks, JSON for metadata).

404.description: Public sample or file not found

get.description: Authenticated JPEG thumbnail for a public sample. Streamed through this release-keyed endpoint (never a signed GCS URL). Never reserves or spends credits.

404.description: No currently-public sample matches the given publicId
